result.title: CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering
result.summary: Episodic-memory embodied question answering enables agents to answer questions based on previously recorded visual observations of the surrounding scenes. However, growing observation histories, varying observation quality across viewpoints, and limited computational resources make it challenging to construct and maintain compact visual memories while retrieving sufficient evidence for question answering. To address these challenges, we introduce CoverMem, which incorporates three key components: (1) a coverage-constrained memory construction method that selects a compact set of informative full frames satisfying object-quality and representative-scene coverage requirements; (2) a coverage-preserving incremental maintenance strategy that locally reselects only the affected frames to satisfy updated coverage requirements as observations arrive; and (3) a budgeted complementary frame selection method that balances question relevance, additional support for question requirements, and redundancy with selected frames within a fixed budget. Experimental results on three benchmarks covering diverse environments and question types demonstrate that CoverMem improves question-answering performance under limited visual budgets.

AI.brief_summary: 面向具身情节记忆问答，提出 CoverMem：在有限视觉预算下按覆盖率约束挑选代表性全帧、增量维护记忆，并兼顾问题相关性、需求补充与冗余度补选互补帧。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「视觉证据筛选」与预算受限的证据获取问题，其覆盖率与互补性准则可能为 LVR 中的视觉旁路保留和信息坍缩提供可核查的选取标准，但方法停留在帧级检索，与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。
